title: New on OTT Thu 12-Sun 15 Nov 2026: Jailer 2 (Prime Video, 12 Nov); Ranabaali, SOTY: After Dark, Parivarik ManuRanjan, Anbil Avan (13 Nov); Cunk on Cinema (Netflix, 15 Nov)
headline: Jailer 2 Streams Today, Ranabaali Friday: 6 New OTT Titles
caption:
Six new titles reach OTT between Thursday, 12 November and Sunday, 15 November.

Jailer 2, Rajinikanth's Tamil action film, streams on Prime Video from today, Thursday 12 November, four weeks after its 15 October cinema release. It is available in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam and Kannada.

On Friday, 13 November, Ranabaali (Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna) arrives on Netflix in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada and Malayalam. Student of the Year: After Dark, a Hindi murder-mystery series, starts on JioHotstar the same day. Sony LIV adds the Hindi film Parivarik ManuRanjan and the Tamil romantic thriller Anbil Avan.

On Sunday, 15 November, Netflix releases Cunk on Cinema, an English mockumentary series.

Do you wait for big films like Jailer 2 to reach OTT, or catch them in cinemas?

Sources: Prime Video India, Netflix India, JioHotstar, Sony LIV, Khaleej Times, Outlook India, tbreak, Flickonclick, NewsBytes, The Economic Times
